profile.headline: Frontend Web Developer @ Novant Health
profile.summary:
I'm Jackeline Mendoza and I'm an aspiring front end developer. I'm a motivated and enthusiastic
apprentice at Road to Hire who wants to pursue a career in technology. I started coding during my
junior year of high school and loved it ever since. I'm always looking to improve and broaden my
knowledge and experience.
